tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.tribe.0: The green ones came for their share again. We pay, and their war bands walk past our gate. Better than burning.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.tribe.1: We owe the tribes a little every few days. The humans call it shameful. The humans aren't raided.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.tribe.2: An orc stood at the gate this morning with his hand out. Our elder filled it. That's peace, out here.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.tribe.3: They raid the human towns and leave us be, so long as the purse is full. Funny kind of friendship.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.ogre.0: The ogre king's men took their share again. He sits up there fat as a hill on what we earn.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.ogre.1: Every day the same. Something for the king in the stone hall, or he comes down himself.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.ogre.2: Somebody ought to put that ogre king in the ground. Then we'd keep what we make.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.ogre.3: His hoard's full of our coin, you know. Every coin in it once passed through this square.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.short.0: The coffers were empty when the ogre king's due came. Nobody sleeps well tonight.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.short.1: We couldn't pay him. He'll remember. They always remember.
tribute.jaymoskingdoms.haven.short.2: Short again. If the king in the stone hall gets hungry, it's us he'll come for.
